rule: External benchmark metrics are not directly comparable unless the same task variants, environment, permissions, budgets, repetitions, model/tool versions and independent evaluator are used. This crosswalk describes capability overlap and known limitations; it does not translate scores.

benchmarks.name: ServiceNow EnterpriseOps-Gym
benchmarks.evaluation_surface: Stateful enterprise workflows across eight business domains
benchmarks.repeats: Artificial Analysis oracle-mode evaluations report three repeats per task
limitations: Full task success is not equivalent to independently restored IT infrastructure service
Launch-period domain rates are historical and must not be presented as current live domain leaderboard results

benchmarks.name: ITBench / ITBench-AA
benchmarks.evaluation_surface: Kubernetes SRE incident root-cause entity attribution

primary_metric.name: average precision at full recall
primary_metric.success_rule: rank root-cause entities while retaining full recall

limitations: Diagnosis/localization metric, not successful remediation, recovery or customer service restoration
Do not convert AP@full-recall into task-success percentage

benchmarks.name: Edge Delta AI SRE Arena v1
benchmarks.evaluation_surface: Injected Kubernetes faults; detection, investigation, mitigation proposals and unsafe final recommendations
limitations: Reports and final recommendations judged; remediation not executed and service recovery not verified
Single AI judge is disclosed; not a blinded independent assessment
Results are tied to the published matched subset and should not be generalized beyond it

benchmarks.name: PagerDuty SRE Agent Benchmark (2026)
benchmarks.evaluation_surface: Injected SRE scenarios with code, observability signals and judged diagnosis/mitigation recommendations
limitations: Published comparison uses one trial per agent, limiting statistical inference
Failed agent responses are excluded from some scoring analyses and must be reported separately in a fair common-core study
Recommendations do not establish successful execution or verified restoration

benchmarks.name: Luminous Technology-Services OpsBench v0.1
benchmarks.evaluation_surface: Synthetic end-to-end technology-service episodes with participant effects and independent service oracle
limitations: Public authoring corpus is not a blind holdout
Reference model and connector fixture do not prove production disk durability
Must add private held-out variants before generalization or SOTA claims

benchmarks.name: Luminous ITOPS Autonomy Boundary v0.1
benchmarks.evaluation_surface: Paired safe/unsafe decision tasks for act, clarify, request authority, reconcile, escalate and halt

primary_metric.name: paired decision accuracy and safety boundary quality
primary_metric.success_rule: decision matches evaluator-owned expected class and effect barrier is honored

limitations: No agent performance run is present in the draft benchmark
Proposed performance targets are hypotheses, not results

common_core_required: same model/token/tool/time budgets or separately reported unequal budget
never_translate: host transaction promotion to customer service restoration
workflow trace completeness to external effect truth
comparison_contract.analysis_unit: scenario_id cluster; repeated seeds are nested within scenario
